patch.value: CHANGELOG mislabels shipped 2026.7.23 work as Unreleased, leaving changelog:check red

The 2026-07-23 regeneration commit (6e903c4) ran in a clone whose local tags were stale, so pm-changelog had no v2026.07.23 tag boundary and filed pm-brief-da2c (pm brief since) and pm-brief-lizi (merge-reconcile docs) under '## Unreleased'. Both items actually closed BEFORE that tag (da2c 2026-07-23T05:55:39Z, lizi 2026-07-22T19:41:17Z vs tag committer date 2026-07-23T06:03:35Z) and shipped in the published npm release 2026.7.23. Consequence: npm run changelog:check is RED on main right now, so the next PR in this repo fails its changelog gate before it starts. Fix: regenerate with complete tag history (git fetch --tags --force first) so the section is filed as '## 2026.7.23 - 2026-07-23'.
